tests.how: With SP-1's setup: 1) `npm run dev` and open http://localhost:3000/login, sign in as admin@prueba.local. 2) Open Administración → Cuentas, invite yourself a new person with role «Usuario · Designer Plus», copy the link. 3) Open the link in a private window: set a password, read and accept the data notice. Then, as administrator, generate a new link for another invited person and open the old one. 4) Back as administrator change that person to «Usuario · Master Designer», create a custom role with two permissions, try to delete «Administrador» and the role in use. 5) In the private window use the account menu → Mi cuenta to change the password, then sign out.
tests.expect: 2) The link appears once with a copy button. 3) The notice is in your browser's language; without ticking it the account cannot be activated; activation signs the person in directly; the old link of the other person says it is no longer valid. The person sees the chat and the costs tool, and /3d shows «sin acceso». 4) After the role change, reloading /3d opens the Taller; system roles are read-only and the role in use cannot be deleted, each with a clear reason. 5) The new password works and the old one does not. Screens match the approved `cuentas-admin@v1` mockup at phone and desktop width.  Verify local dev/no-cookie home and login use the same local administrator as API guards, mode-off retains login, and production/non-loopback/forged-forwarding never enable local access.  With local mode on and no cookie, click from home via header/account menu and Administración to accounts; mode-off signed-out and non-admin menus must not expose unauthorized administrator links.
